nodes.name: AI: Triage Urgency & Draft Empathy Reply (JSON)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', temperature: 0.1, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are a Customer Experience triage assistant. Return strictly JSON: theme (not_received | product_quality | delivery_delay | customer_service | other), priority_tier (P0 | P1 | P2 | P3), owner_team (logistics_cs | product_quality | logistics | customer_service), hold_days (7 | 14 | 30), internal_reply_draft (short empathetic draft for a human agent; NEVER promise unapproved refunds or discounts), escalation_flags (array).' }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify($json) } ] }) }}

nodes.notes: Strict JSON contract. Draft reply is saved ONLY as an internal note for human agent review.

nodes.name: Klaviyo: Set cx_promo_hold = true

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ data: { type: 'profile', attributes: { email: $('Webhook: Carrier / Trustpilot / Zendesk Event').item.json.body.email, properties: { cx_promo_hold: true, cx_review_request_hold: true, cx_hold_reason: JSON.parse($json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '{}').theme || 'cx_issue_open', cx_priority_tier: JSON.parse($json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '{}').priority_tier || 'P2' } } } }) }}

nodes.notes: Immediately adds customer to Klaviyo Global Promo Exclusion Segment and pauses automated review requests.
